review:
BGaming's version of the fishing-collect game, on 5x4 reels with 10 lines. A friendly angler is the wild, and fish symbols carry values he can reel in.

The free spins can run to 30 or more, and every 10 spins the wins get boosted – 2x, then 3x, then 10x – so a long bonus genuinely builds. Very high volatility and a 5,000x cap. The 97.2% RTP is the selling point: if you like Big Bass but want better long-term odds, try this one. Free spins about once every 205 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.20% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
